LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SpringFlow.label: spring flow
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SpringFlow.description: Unlocks Flower Decree: Spring Flow.\n\nSummon spring water to continuously heal allied targets in the area.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chuanhun.label: soulbreak absolute note
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chuanhun.description: Unlocks Flower Decree: Spirit Burst.\n\nUnleash an extremely long-range sonic burst, stunning enemies in a small area and dealing damage. Extra effect: Flower Decree maximum +1.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Shuangyuejing.label: frost bloom
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Shuangyuejing.description: Unlocks Flower Decree: Lunar Mirror.\n\nSummon a shield that intercepts all hostile projectiles passing through it for a time. Extra effect: Flower Decree maximum +1.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaoshan.label: mountain resolve
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaoshan.description: Unlocks passive: increases personal shield maximum by 150%.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Liushui.label: flowing resilience
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Liushui.description: Unlocks passive: increases personal shield recharge rate by 200%.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chunjiang.label: river moon intent
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chunjiang.description: Unlocks passive: reduces the shield downtime after breaking to 2 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_DivineGrace.label: Flower-God Benediction
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_DivineGrace.description: Unlocks a repeatable passive. Each level improves base stats, shield stats, and Flower Decree recovery speed.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Yingyue.label: moon-reflection fragment
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Yingyue.description: Unlocks Eye of Heart and allows Flower-God Mercy to store 1 additional charge.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_IllusoryReflection.label: Illusory Reflection
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_IllusoryReflection.descriptio: Unlocks Illusory Reflection, an uninterruptible sword stance that counters nearby attacks and mitigates attacks from farther away.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.label: Sword Form: Jueying
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.description: A sword technique Qinghe developed after exchanging forms with her teacher Neiyu. Bell tones become sword qi, combining the breathtaking speed of Sword Form: Skyfall with Qinghe's own cutting art.\n\nUnlocks Sword Form: Jueying. Dash in the chosen direction, then leap and pursue after hitting a target. On landing, consume all Sword Pressure to empower the attack into seven area slashes; without Sword Pressure, perform three single-target slashes.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.label: Luoshui rite
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.description: Unlocks active ability: Luoshen's Ribbon, greatly improving the opinion between any two colonists.\n\nUnlocks passive: Luoshui Rite, improving Qinghe's social impact and mood. If she has a spouse, it also establishes a psychic bond.
